title: Study on the Effect of Rosuvastatin Treatment on the Prevention of Thrombosis in Patients With Previous Thrombosis

sections.abstract: This study evaluates whether treatment with rosuvastatin on top of standard anti-coagulant treatment will decrease the risk of recurrent venous thromboembolism and arterial thromboembolic events in patients with previous deep vein thrombosis or pulmonary embolism.
